title: Queue
definition: A First-In, First-Out (FIFO) data structure. Array `shift()` is O(N) in JS, so a true O(1) Queue requires a custom Linked List implementation.
simpleExplanation: A line at the grocery store. The first person in line is the first person served.

**Intermediate 2:** Handle edge cases like empty inputs or circular references in Queue.
**Advanced:** Optimize time or space complexity using advanced patterns for Queue.
